description: The SOC codes employers filed a job title under in DOL's PERM, prevailing wage and LCA files, with each code's share of the title's filings. For a code: its title, O*NET's description and core tasks, the titles employers filed most under it, and its PERM approval rate and median offered wage (under the site's floors). For a 2010 code: the 2018 codes it became. No key, under the same shared limits as the employer lookup. Example: {"q":"data scientist"}.

q.description: A job title or a SOC code (15-1252, 15-1252.00 or 151252), 2 to 80 characters. Example: data scientist.

name: lookup_soc
